**skull** is a project in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md). Its code is written mainly in [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md) (72.1 %), with [Ruby](@/glossary/ruby.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 20 May 2014; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 3 August 2014. It reads “Updated git submodule - cpp”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2014, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/skull) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/skull).

Related work in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md): [grache-test](@/work/grache-test.md) (2015), [skull-ruby](@/work/skull-ruby.md) (2014), [malina](@/work/malina.md) (2013) and [skull-elixir](@/work/skull-elixir.md) (2016).
